title: chore: restore applied relationship RPC migration
purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更

body:
## Purpose
Restore the canonical Git-managed SQL source for the Relationship Server RPC change that was already applied to production on 2026-09-30 13:19:30.016 UTC.

## Scope
- Adds `supabase/migrations/20260930131930_relationship_server_rpc_user_context.sql`.
- The function definitions and grants are reconstructed from the production migration/log record.
- No production database change is performed by this PR.
- This is a source-of-truth restoration, not a new production migration to execute against the existing database.

## Audit note
The production migration record did not contain rollback SQL. The original GitHub migration file could not be found on `main`; the production log remains the evidence for the applied SQL.

code_facts.expression: create or replace function public.get_relationship_time_context(p_user_id uuid default null)
if auth.uid() is not null and coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false) then raise exception 'permanent account required'; end if;
revoke all on function public.get_relationship_time_context(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.get_relationship_time_context(uuid) to service_role;
create or replace function public.record_relationship_chat_turn(p_user_message_at timestamptz,p_misaki_message_at timestamptz,p_user_id uuid default null)
if auth.uid() is not null and coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false) then raise exception 'permanent account required'; end if;
if found and v_before.last_interaction_at is not null then v_elapsed_seconds:=greatest(floor(extract(epoch from(v_user_at-v_before.last_interaction_at)))::bigint,0); end if;
revoke all on function public.record_relationship_chat_turn(timestamptz,timestamptz,uuid) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.record_relationship_chat_turn(timestamptz,timestamptz,uuid) to service_role;
